name: monimal
description: Monorepo spike: maximal, maximal-core and maximal-electron in one pnpm workspace, driven by Turborepo.

scripts.test:maximal-configurators:inner: node scripts/assert-test-container.mjs && pnpm --filter @stuffbucket/maximal-configurators test && pnpm --filter @stuffbucket/maximal-core run test:configurator-harness
scripts.test:connections:inner: node scripts/assert-test-container.mjs && pnpm --filter @stuffbucket/maximal-configurators test && pnpm --filter @stuffbucket/maximal-core test && pnpm --filter maximal-client test
scripts.mutate:core:inner: node scripts/assert-test-container.mjs && pnpm --filter @stuffbucket/maximal-core exec stryker run
scripts.check:core: pnpm --filter @stuffbucket/maximal-core run check:deep:host && pnpm run test:core
scripts.check: pnpm run check:static && pnpm run check:cross-package-duplicates && pnpm --filter @stuffbucket/maximal-core run check:deep:host && pnpm test
